title: Geometry - Lesson 3 Assessment: Parallelogram Property Problems
description: Show that you can choose and apply parallelogram properties in side, angle, diagonal, and area problems.

questions.question: Which statement is always true for parallelogram $ABCD$?
options: All four angles are right angles
questions.explanation: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are congruent, so $AB = CD$.

questions.question: In parallelogram $MNPQ$, $m\angle M = 47^\circ$. What is $m\angle P$?
questions.explanation: $\angle M$ and $\angle P$ are opposite angles, and opposite angles in a parallelogram are congruent.

questions.question: In parallelogram $RSTU$, $m\angle R = 124^\circ$. What is $m\angle S$?
questions.explanation: Consecutive angles in a parallelogram are supplementary, so $180 - 124 = 56$.

questions.question: Diagonals of parallelogram $ABCD$ intersect at $E$. If $BE = 2x + 3$ and $ED = 17$, then $x = $ ______.
questions.explanation: The diagonals bisect each other, so $BE = ED$. Then $2x + 3 = 17$, so $x = 7$.

questions.question: A parallelogram has area $135$ square units and base $15$ units. Its height is ______ units.
questions.explanation: Use $A = bh$. Since $135 = 15h$, the height is $9$ units.

questions.question: In every parallelogram, consecutive angles are congruent.
questions.explanation: Consecutive angles are supplementary. Opposite angles are congruent.

questions.question: In parallelogram $DEFG$, $DE = 4x - 1$ and $FG = 31$. What is $x$?
questions.explanation: Opposite sides are congruent, so $4x - 1 = 31$. Then $4x = 32$ and $x = 8$.

questions.question: In parallelogram $ABCD$, $m\angle A = 3x + 5$ and $m\angle B = 2x + 25$. Find $x$.
questions.explanation: $A$ and $B$ are consecutive angles, so their sum is $180^\circ$. This gives $5x + 30 = 180$, so $x = 30$.

questions.question: Explain why a slanted side length of $10$ cm cannot automatically be used as the height of a parallelogram.
questions.correctAnswer: Height is the perpendicular distance from the base to the opposite side. A slanted side can be used as the height only if it is perpendicular to the base.
questions.explanation: The area formula $A = bh$ requires perpendicular height, not just any side length.

questions.question: Diagonals of parallelogram $JKLM$ intersect at $N$. If $JN = 12$ and $LN = 15$, what can you conclude about $NK$ and $NM$?
questions.correctAnswer: $NK = 12$ and $NM = 15$ because diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other.
questions.explanation: $JN$ and $NK$ are halves of one diagonal, while $LN$ and $NM$ are halves of the other diagonal.
